packageRules.description: Hold getrandom at 0.2. The direct 0.2 entry turns on the js feature for the getrandom 0.2 copy that ring and rand_core also use on wasm32, and getrandom 0.3 removed that feature, so a bump past 0.2 fails the Cargo.lock update. It waits under Pending Approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening a PR that cannot pass. Vulnerability updates are not held: Renovate forces dependencyDashboardApproval off for them. Drop this rule once nothing in Cargo.lock depends on getrandom 0.2.

Hold js-sys and wasm-bindgen-test. wasm-bindgen-test is pinned exactly, it pins js-sys and wasm-bindgen exactly in turn, and CI's wasm-bindgen-test-runner must match the locked wasm-bindgen, so these move together by hand with the runner pin in ci.yml. A Renovate update to either one fails the Cargo.lock update and takes its whole group with it, so it waits under Pending Approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead. Vulnerability updates are not held.
